answer: An agent economy can resist sybils by binding identity to a scarce physical resource, letting each participant stake a unique sable hardware root whose attestation decays as ember unless refreshed by costly work. Validators cross-check these roots against a slow-moving glacier of accumulated proof-of-work history, so forged identities cannot borrow legitimacy without. Correlated defectors incur an exponential capital forfeiture bounded by O(Delta * S).
